role: Staged end-to-end CPU feasibility screen; outcome-aware selector is a diagnostic, not a deployable controller or formal oracle upper bound
age_assignment: Rotate the public age vector by the block index; clip source versions at zero during startup
packet_semantics: Five Adam actor steps at the source version, sent as a parameter increment and source optimizer state; add the scaled increment to the current distinct actor and accept the source optimizer state only when launched
reward: Mean of agents' native rewards, without shaping; stochastic-policy undiscounted episodic return is the reported benchmark metric
sampling: Native independent joint episodes; common environment seeds and per-episode action uniforms across methods and candidate policies
controller_roles: history_surrogate sees current training data and only previously completed packet increments before launch; only the outcome_aware_oracle reads its separately charged search returns; benchmark evaluation returns never control a deployable method
resource_semantics: Joint environment sampling is paid for all agents; selected actors do not save already collected transitions. One launched packet costs five full-batch actor optimizer passes and one gradient-packet message. Credits accrue before launch, with a bank capped at team size. HAPPO full cadence may spend a banked full-team credit. Oracle counterfactual packet work, search rollouts, and proxy forward work are recorded separately, never free deployable evidence.
baseline_selection: Select one strongest non-oracle method per task by development-seed mean raw-return AUC; freeze that selection before holdout analysis. Also retain separate HAPPO-cyclic comparison.
relative_gain: (method AUC - comparator AUC) / max(abs(comparator AUC), 1); computed separately for each seed before averaging
decision: A Stage-A pass permits fresh-seed qualification of an observable action score and fully charged uniform return certificate, not GPU confirmation or manuscript admission. Any failed gate is a no-go for the tested candidate menu. A noisy outcome-aware selector is not a mathematical upper bound and cannot rule out all asynchronous MARL designs.
stop_rule: Preserve every method/task/seed; no threshold changes, outcome retries, or environment removal. Diagnose the failure and make a substantive action/estimator redesign before any separately frozen new experiment. Payload errors stop the scientific run and are recorded.
